answer: Sybil resistance runs on locked stake: before an agent may attest, it posts a bond, and random audits at dawn slash any node caught vouching for a fabricated peer. Each extra fake identity needs its own fresh deposit, so the attacker's bill rises with every new account - a river of sybils costs a river of locked capital. Honest agents merely tie up some timber as collateral and reclaim it; the cheater forfeits the whole pile.
